evidence.reason: The driver computes `created = session_files(sessions_dir) - before` at line 140 precisely to distinguish sessions created by this invocation from pre-existing job-store entries (the `before`/`created` diff only makes sense if the store persists across invocations/rungs). Yet the value-level sessionId fallback at lines 164-165 compares/selects from `stored`, the full store listing. When a deferred rung retries in the same directory and the new invocation fails before creating a session, `created` is empty while `stored` can hold exactly the one prior rung's session, so `len(stored) == 1` assigns `stored[0]` and writes `session.json`'s `sessionId` pointing at the earlier invocation's session rather than leaving it null. `sessionIds` is already written from `stored`, so only the singular fallback needs `created` (e.g. `Path(next(iter(created))).stem`), matching the suggested fix. This is an ordinary correctness defect in the existing session-link behavior (item 2.3), not a new requirement.
